fact_check.claim: Community Work-Study places about 250 students a year in arts, K-12, environmental, health, legal, older adults, public works, women's organizations, youth programs
fact_check.note: Page says about 250 students and lists these fields.

fact_check.claim: Current postings: Catholic Charities clothing closet assistant; YMCA lifeguard and swim instructor; History Center docent and communications; Cherry Arts production associate
fact_check.note: All listed on the page (the page also lists Finger Lakes ReUse and a YMCA program lead, not mentioned in the article; fine).

fact_check.claim: Needs I-9 on file, FWS eligibility confirmed in Workday, full-time registration, no holds; EEE does not subsidize wages
fact_check.note: Matches the student requirements section.

fact_check.claim: FWS covers at least 75% of CWSP wages; 100% for America Reads/Counts pre-K to 9th grade
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Program suggests 15 to 20 hours a week during the academic year
fact_check.note: Page says students are advised to work no more than 15-20 hours.

fact_check.claim: Timesheets in Workday every two weeks, due noon Wednesday
fact_check.note: Due by noon every other Wednesday. 'In Workday' is not stated on the fetched summary, minor.

fact_check.claim: No holiday/vacation pay; NY paid sick leave 1 hour per 30 worked, up to 56 hours a year
fact_check.note: Page: up to 56 hours or 7 days per calendar year.

fact_check.claim: Hours over 40 paid at 1.5x and billed to the employer
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Two weeks' notice; cwsp@cornell.edu; universities do not count as a community; remote needs Remote Work Arrangement form and must be in U.S.
fact_check.note: All on the page. The earlier 'no information sessions' sentence is gone.

fact_check.claim: Student and Campus Life lists Community Work-Study among options; every position in Workday notes work-study eligibility, pay range, dates, weekly hours
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Log in to Workday with NetID and password, then search Find Jobs - student
fact_check.note: Fix applied; matches the page.

fact_check.claim: Most units hire in spring or summer for fall; some always hiring
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell suggests looking in Collegetown or the Commons
fact_check.note: Page: 'you can always look off-campus in the Ithaca community, perhaps in Collegetown or in the Commons.' The article's 'suggests as an option' is fair.

fact_check.claim: Valet Driver, Canopy by Hilton: full-time and part-time, hourly pay plus tips, posted 10/08/2026
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: PM Line Cook, Canopy: part-time or full-time, $19-$21, posted 08/26/2026
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Night Auditor, Hotel Ithaca: part-time or full-time, from $16, posted 10/08/2026
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Valet Supervisor $21-$22, posted 10/04/2026; hours not stated
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Shuttle van driver at Hotel Ithaca $16, posted 04/22/2026; Fairfield Inn night auditor $18 posted 08/26/2026, hours not stated
fact_check.note: Source says 'from $16'; article says '$16' in two places, immaterial. Hours labelled not stated, correct.

fact_check.claim: Fairfield Inn breakfast attendant $17; Canopy housekeeper $17-$18
fact_check.note: Matches. The housekeeper listing was posted 06/04/2026, so 'saw in November 2026' means seen then, not posted then; acceptable.

fact_check.claim: Chamber filters: location City of Ithaca, Downtown Ithaca BID, Tompkins County; categories incl. Food Industry and Restaurants, Hotel, Gaming, Leisure, and Travel
fact_check.note: Matches; the page also has Out of Tompkins County.

fact_check.claim: NYS minimum wage outside NYC, Long Island, Westchester is $16.00 and stays the same on January 1, 2027
fact_check.note: Page says $16.00 for 2026 and 2027 (the 2026 figure is implied by 'stays the same').

fact_check.claim: First-year degree students get unlimited TCAT rides; privileges end Aug 31 (fall entrants) and Dec 31 (spring entrants)
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: After first year: free after 6 p.m. weekdays and all day weekends; daytime needs OmniRide pass; discounted pass available; general rate $200 a year prorated monthly via MyParking.Cornell.Edu; PhD students and graduate assistants free
fact_check.note: Matches. 'Registered students' maps to the page's stay-registered condition.

fact_check.claim: If CU ID not accepted you may need to pay $1.50 cash fare
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: November 2024 Sun report says drivers should override the farebox if ID rejected during free hours
fact_check.note: Sun says drivers were instructed to override the farebox. Article labels it as dated and conflicting with the official page.

fact_check.claim: F-1 CPT limited to work directly related to major and a curricular requirement, no more than 20 hours a week in fall and spring; August 2026 SEVP guidance narrowed eligibility
fact_check.note: Matches the CPT page. The line about retail or restaurant jobs not qualifying is the article's inference from that rule, worded with 'generally'. The bullet covers only F-1 CPT, not J-1; the 'talk to International Services' advice covers both.

fact_check.claim: Pay table: Collegetown and Commons pay 'not published; ask the employer'
fact_check.note: Honest non-claim; the source gives no pay.

fact_check.claim: I-9 must be completed before starting work (Common mistakes)
fact_check.note: Page says an I-9 on file is required; 'before starting' is the natural reading but not worded on the page. Minor.

beats_top.query: ithaca part time jobs for cornell students
beats_top.why: The top result is a dated (July 1) Cornell Dining on-campus recruiting post with no off-campus content and no hourly wage. Our page opens with the answer (Community Work-Study, Chamber board, Collegetown), gives dated listings with pay, the NYS minimum wage and TCAT access.
changes: Optional: add a one-line pointer to Cornell Dining and Workday on-campus jobs near the top for students who just want any job.
Optional: re-check the Chamber listings before each publish, since they are dated.
